title: Book Three · Chapter 142: A Moment Before the Song
story:
On Friday, Ronan reaches the music room before three.

The teacher is moving chairs near the front. Two students help her while Ronan checks the space beside the window.

One singer needs to leave early. The teacher moves that song to the first place.

Ronan changes the order on his list. He tells the other performers before the audience comes in.

At three, the room is almost full. Ronan stands at the front with the page in his hands.

He gives the welcome too quickly. Then he sees Kai at the back, waiting for the next words.

Ronan takes a breath and begins the first name more slowly.

The first song goes well. The singer thanks the room and collects her bag. Ronan waits until she is clear of the front, then brings the chair forward for the guitar.

The next girl sits down and puts her fingers on the strings.

She looks at the audience, then down at her hands. She does not look up at Ronan yet.

He waits.

The teacher brings her a little water. She drinks, sets the cup down, and tries one quiet note.

Ronan keeps his page low. At last, the girl looks up and nods.

He says her name and the song title. Then he moves away from the chair.

Her first line is very soft. The next is clearer. People near the back lean forward to listen.

Ronan sits at the side and follows the words. Near the end, Anna comes through the door. She sits beside Lin at the back.

When the song finishes, the room claps. The girl stands with her guitar and smiles toward the teacher.

Ronan moves the chair aside before he introduces the next pair.

By four, the last song is over. The teacher thanks everyone, and students begin to take the chairs back.

Ronan helps carry two. The girl puts her guitar in its bag beside the door.

“Thank you,” she says. “I needed that moment.”

“I liked your last line.”

She smiles. “That is my favourite part.”

Outside, Anna waits with Lin and Kai.

“You could hear me?” Ronan asks.

“From the door,” Anna says.

Kai lifts a hand. “From the back too.”

Ronan folds the list and puts it in his bag. Anna takes his arm as they leave.

At the gate, he asks about her drawing talk. She begins with the stair, and he slows beside her to hear the rest.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

string＝琴弦；lean forward＝向前倾；clap＝鼓掌；favourite＝最喜欢的。

## 理解问题

1. 顺序改变后，Ronan在观众进来前做了什么？
2. 弹吉他的女孩还没准备好时，他怎样处理？她后来有没有自己完成表演？

## 读句子

**At last, the girl looks up and nods.**

拆开看：At last, / the girl / looks up / and nods.

终于／女孩／抬起头／并点头示意。
